knownEvidenceLimitations: Some game title, platform, version, patch, and exact creation-path proof is not visible in source-media footage.
Some selector first/final/wrap boundaries and complete native counts are not proven by existing footage.
Some categories have limited profile or secondary-angle coverage.
Some settings are visible only briefly or with non-ideal framing.
Some dependency tests are not present as controlled one-variable tests.
Current media is research evidence until human verification and catalog-manager approval classify supported options.
existingUnresolvedBoundaries: Do not infer missing native labels, indices, counts, menu paths, or slider ranges from incomplete footage.
Do not treat exact duplicate uploads as new evidence coverage.
Do not use limited or unsupported options as high-confidence recommendations.
Do not promote records without second-person verification and catalog-manager approval.

remainingRecaptureTasksBecome: Unsupported option/category where evidence is insufficient
reclassificationPolicy.unsupportedOrInsufficientEvidenceBehavio: Disable or omit the affected option/category rather than inventing it or blocking the entire product.
reclassificationPolicy.supportedSubsetBehavior: Recommendations may use only sufficiently supported, version-compatible, non-fixture options from the locked baseline after verification and approval gates pass.

dayOneProductTargets.scoreInterpretation: Product build-match score based on available in-game controls, not identity probability or scientific certainty.

productionStatus.notes: The owner media baseline is locked, but production promotion still requires supported evidence classification, second-human verification, catalog-manager approval, and fail-closed release validation.
